reason: Phagocytes are shown engulfing debris near the cut, so they seem useful for starting the wound cleanup.
expectation: The cells will clear debris from the wound while the vessel remains sealed.

alternatives.reason: The signal arrow points toward the vessel, suggesting another repair step.

effect: The debris is cleared, and the wound now has supply, surface, and support slots to fill.
reaction: The separate slots make the remaining repair jobs clearer.
reason: The picture shows repair signals pointing to the nearby capillary, suggesting a way to build the wound's blood supply.
expectation: The signals will help the nearby vessel supply the healing wound.

effect: The signals produced a new vessel branch connected to the existing circulation, suggesting it can fill the supply slot.
reaction: The growing branch makes the supply step easy to picture.
reason: The capillary sprout appears to provide the wound's missing blood supply.
expectation: The sprout will fill the supply slot in the healing wound.

effect: The sprout filled the supply slot and formed a connected blood-flow route to the wound.
reaction: Seeing it connect to another vessel makes the supply route clearer.
reason: The fibroblast picture shows a collagen gene and RNA building blocks entering its nucleus, suggesting a first step toward making wound support.
expectation: The fibroblasts will make an RNA message for collagen.

alternatives.reason: The edge cells and nutrients also suggest a way to repair the surface.

effect: The fibroblasts now have a collagen message at their ribosomes, ready for the protein-building materials.
reaction: The picture makes it clear that the DNA stays in the nucleus.
reason: Matrix nutrients include amino acids, which earlier chapters showed cells use to make proteins.
expectation: The fibroblasts will use the amino acids and collagen message to make supporting material.

effect: The fibroblasts made and exported collagen fibres, providing new connective tissue for wound support.
reaction: The sequence connects the collagen message to the fibres outside the cells.
reason: The new connective tissue appears to fit the wound's support slot.
expectation: The connective tissue will fill the support slot in the healing wound.

effect: The new connective tissue filled the support slot; the surface still needs repair, and the young tissue is not yet as strong as uninjured skin.
reaction: It is useful to see that closing a wound does not immediately restore its full strength.
reason: The surface edge cells and their nutrients suggest a way to replace the missing surface.
expectation: The edge cells will use the nutrients to help produce a new wound surface.

effect: The edge cells formed a new surface sheet extending across the gap, ready for the remaining surface slot.
reaction: The sheet growing from the wound edge makes the closure easy to picture.
reason: The new surface matches the healing body's remaining surface slot.

choice.combine: Body with healing skin[Capillary sprout,New connective tissue]

expectation: The new surface will fill the surface slot and close the wound.

effect: The new surface filled the last slot, completing wound closure, support and supply; the deeper tissue is still gaining strength.
reaction: The closed surface and still-strengthening tissue make the stages of healing clearer.
reason: The remaining goal is to clear the temporary clot, and the enzymes are shown breaking down fibrin threads.

choice.combine: Body with healing skin[Capillary sprout,New connective tissue,New surface]

expectation: The enzymes will break down the temporary fibrin clot in the healed wound.

effect: The temporary clot was cleared, completing both goals; the scar and its collagen are still maturing.
reaction: It was useful to see that repair continues after the skin closes.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making collagen support was most worthwhile: the RNA message, protein building and fibres outside the cells connected earlier cell biology to wound repair.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding each finished piece to its matching slot felt a little repetitive, although the pictures showed what each contributed.

surprise.text: The new tissue is not immediately as strong as uninjured skin, even after the surface closes.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the pictures and named slots made the pairings understandable.

continue.text: I would probably continue: following the wound from a sealed vessel to a closing surface and a maturing scar made the separate repair jobs fit together.
